title: c-PCR-004 Wires, cables and accessories, except construction products (to PCR 2024:06)
program_operator: EPD International AB (The International EPD System)

document.status_note: Validity taken from the document; current status on environdec.com not checked. Adopted from PEP Ecopassport PSR-0001-ed4-EN-2022 11 16.

depends_on_unavailable: PEP Ecopassport PSR-0001-ed4-EN-2022 11 16 (Specific rules for wires, cables and accessories) - functional unit (§3.1), use-stage/energy-loss modelling, RSL, default scenarios (§3.4), extrapolation (§3.5), joint declarations (§3.6)
PEP Ecopassport PEP-PCR ed4-EN 2021 09 06 - specific rules for EPDs intended for the French market

rules.title: Construction-sector cables excluded
rules.requirement: This c-PCR shall not be used for wires, cables and accessories for the construction sector (covered by 2019:14-c-PCR-019, adopted from EPD Norway).

rules.title: Product is a wire, cable or accessory
rules.requirement: The c-PCR covers wires, cables and accessories (as defined in PEP Ecopassport PSR-0001-ed4) that are not construction products.

rules.title: Used together with PCR 2024:06
rules.requirement: The c-PCR cannot be used alone; the EPD shall reference both PCR 2024:06 (any valid version) and this c-PCR.

rules.title: Issued within c-PCR validity
rules.requirement: The c-PCR (v1.0.0, published 2025-08-27) is valid until 2027-11-16; the EPD should be issued within that window.

rules.title: c-PCR registration number cited
rules.requirement: References to this c-PCR shall include its registration number (2024:06-c-PCR-004), name and version.

rules.title: c-PCR name cited
rules.requirement: References to this c-PCR shall include its name 'Wires, cables and accessories, except construction products'.

rules.title: Original adopted PSR named
rules.requirement: As the c-PCR is adopted from PEP Ecopassport, the PCR information shall name the original document and version (PSR-0001-ed4-EN-2022 11 16).

rules.title: c-PCR review information
rules.requirement: The PCR information shall include the c-PCR review details (Technical Committee of EPD International as review panel, chair Rui Wang).

rules.title: c-PCR listed in references section
rules.requirement: The references section shall list the c-PCR used (registration number, name, version).

rules.title: Results declared per functional unit only
rules.requirement: Unlike PSR-0001 §3.1, results shall be declared only per functional unit; declaring per declared unit (alone or in addition) is not allowed.

rules.title: No per-declared-unit results
rules.requirement: The EPD shall not present environmental performance results per declared unit.

rules.title: UN CPC code in product description section
rules.requirement: If an applicable UN CPC code exists, it shall be stated in the product description section of the EPD.

rules.title: PSR-0001 default end-of-life scenario used
rules.requirement: Where PCR 2024:06 requires scenarios (e.g. end-of-life), the scenarios and default values of PSR-0001-ed4 should be used.

rules.title: Non-default end-of-life scenario justified
rules.requirement: If an end-of-life scenario other than PSR-0001-ed4 defaults is used, it shall be justified in the LCA report and the EPD.

rules.title: PSR-0001 default use scenario used
rules.requirement: Where a use-stage scenario is required, PSR-0001-ed4 scenarios and default values should be used.

rules.title: Non-default use scenario justified
rules.requirement: If a use-stage scenario other than PSR-0001-ed4 defaults is used, it shall be justified in the LCA report and the EPD.

rules.title: Content declaration mandatory
rules.requirement: The EPD shall include all mandatory declarations of PCR 2024:06, including the content declaration.

rules.title: Share of specific data mandatory
rules.requirement: The EPD shall include the share-of-specific-data declaration required by PCR 2024:06.

rules.title: Declaration called EPD, not PEP
rules.requirement: References to 'Product Environmental Profiles' (PEP) in PSR-0001 are replaced by 'Environmental Product Declaration'; the document should not call itself a PEP.

manual_checks.title: Functional unit, RSL and use scenario per PSR-0001-ed4
manual_checks.reason: The cable functional unit, reference service life, use-stage modelling (e.g. energy losses) and default scenarios are defined in PSR-0001-ed4-EN-2022 11 16, which was not provided; verify the project against that document.

manual_checks.title: French market rules (PEP-PCR ed4)
manual_checks.reason: EPDs intended for the French market shall follow specific rules of PEP-PCR ed4-EN 2021 09 06; the rules are not in this document and the target-market decision needs review.

manual_checks.title: Zero only for calculated-zero values
manual_checks.reason: Indicators may be declared '0' only when calculated to be zero (all indicators); requires inspection of the model, not just the result table.

manual_checks.title: Homogeneous families follow PCR 2024:06, not PSR-0001 §3.5
manual_checks.reason: PSR-0001 extrapolation rules for homogeneous environmental families shall not be used; PCR 2024:06 'Multiple products from the same company' (§4.9.1) applies instead. Requires checking the method used.

manual_checks.title: Joint declarations follow sector-EPD rules, not PSR-0001 §3.6
manual_checks.reason: Joint environmental declarations shall follow the PCR 2024:06 'Sector EPDs' rules (§4.9.2) instead of PSR-0001 §3.6.

manual_checks.title: Choice among several applicable c-PCRs
manual_checks.reason: If more than one c-PCR applies, the most function-specific is recommended, or several may be used if non-conflicting; needs judgement.

manual_checks.title: Product in PSR-0001 scope
manual_checks.reason: Whether the product is a wire, cable or accessory as defined in PSR-0001-ed4 (not provided) requires review.

manual_checks.title: LCA report content
manual_checks.reason: LCA report content shall follow PCR 2024:06 and PSR-0001-ed4; report review is manual.

notes: This c-PCR is short and adopts PSR-0001-ed4 by reference. The cable functional unit (e.g. per length of cable), RSL, use-phase assumptions (current, load rate, operating hours) and energy-loss calculation formula are NOT stated in either supplied PDF - they live in PSR-0001-ed4, which was not provided. No FU value, use-phase formula or default scenario values were invented; `defaults` is empty and must be filled from PSR-0001 before use.
The parent's TEC formula (PCR2024-06.USE.01) covers mains-connected equipment operating modes and the parent says it is not applicable to electronic components; it is not a cable energy-loss formula.

Overrides PCR2024-06.FU.01 (functional OR declared unit): only a functional unit is allowed (CPCR004.FU.01/FU.02); PCR2024-06.FU.05, FU.06 and FU.07 (declared-unit rules) therefore never apply under this c-PCR.
Overrides PCR2024-06.FMT.S04 'if relevant' condition: the content declaration is mandatory (CPCR004.DOC.01). Restates PCR2024-06.DQ.08 (share of specific data) as mandatory (CPCR004.DOC.02).
Extends PCR2024-06.DOC.28: the UN CPC code, if applicable, must appear in the product description section (CPCR004.CPC.01).

PSR-0001 §3.4 default scenarios are subordinated to PCR 2024:06 §4.7.5 data-quality/modelling rules; PSR defaults are recommended where PCR 2024:06 requires scenarios (CPCR004.SCN.*). SCN.03/SCN.04 extend this to the use stage by inference (the c-PCR names end-of-life only as an example).
PSR-0001 §3.5 (homogeneous-family extrapolation) is replaced by PCR2024-06.MP.* (§4.9.1); PSR-0001 §3.6 (joint declarations) is replaced by PCR2024-06.SEC.* (§4.9.2).

Data quality (PCR2024-06.DQ.*), electricity modelling (PCR2024-06.EL.*), EPD validity (PCR2024-06.VAL.01, 5 years) and EPD format (PCR2024-06.FMT.*, DOC.*) are inherited unchanged from the parent per c-PCR §2.2.3, §4 and §6.
Precedence: where the main PCR and c-PCR conflict, the c-PCR prevails (§1.2 p4). The c-PCR may be used with any valid version of PCR 2024:06 (§1.2 p3).

Applicability timing: use of an applicable c-PCR becomes mandatory 90 days after publication (2025-08-27 + 90 days = 2025-11-25, derived) and is optional before that (§1.2 p3). The app's PCR selector should require this c-PCR for in-scope cable EPDs issued on/after 2025-11-25.

Parent requirements on c-PCRs not visibly met in the c-PCR text itself (presumably delegated to PSR-0001): define FU and RSL (PCR 2024:06 §4.1, §4.2), product-lifespan guidance (§4.2), a use-stage reference scenario (§4.7.5.2 p29), and which EN 50693 Annex G rule (G.2/G.4) applies (§4.6.2 p22 'should'). The G.2/G.4 choice therefore remains open per parent PCR2024-06.AL.04/AL.05.

Scope ambiguity: the parent defines EEE with voltage rating <=1000 V AC / <=1500 V DC (PCR 2024:06 footnote 4 p7); whether higher-voltage power cables in PSR-0001 scope are covered is not addressed. The parent lists construction-sector cables under UN CPC 463/41513/41533 (c-PCR-019 of PCR 2019:14); CPC 463 alone does not distinguish non-construction cables, so scope is decided by construction-product status (CPCR004.SCOPE.01).

Document inconsistencies: the c-PCR names the main PCR 'Electronic and electric components (non-construction)' (§1.2 p3, §2.2.1 p6) instead of 'Electronic and electric equipment, and electronic components (non-construction)'; contact e-mail is misprinted 'support@environdec.coms' (p5); the references list PSR-0018 (EV charging infrastructure), which appears unrelated, and do not list PSR-0001 itself (p12).
GPI footnote 2 (p6): the latest GPI verification rules shall be followed within 90 days of their publication regardless of the GPI version referenced by the main PCR.

Stage naming follows the parent ruleset (manufacturing, distribution, installation, use, de_installation, end_of_life, total). The rule-level `applies_when` extension and expression conventions are the same as in the parent ruleset notes.

New field paths introduced here (in addition to the parent's list): product.sub_category values 'wire'|'cable'|'cable_accessory', scenarios.end_of_life.{scenario_source,deviation_justification}, scenarios.use.{scenario_source,deviation_justification}.
